subject: PrivInfra technical review & next steps after discovery call
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Aaron Miles <aaron.miles@datascape.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: PrivInfra technical review & next steps after discovery call

Hi Aaron — great to meet earlier. Thanks for walking us through DataScape's current ingestion pipeline and the compliance constraints around PHI retention. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Scope recap: evaluate a Private (VPC) deployment in your AWS account with KMS integration and optional on-prem gateway for legacy systems.
- Goals for next meeting: 1) review network diagram and security controls your infra team expects, 2) walk through a short demo of the Redwood Private control plane and deployment flow, 3) surface any procurement/SOC2 evidence needs.

Can you share who from your infra/security team should join? We suggest a 45-minute technical review + 15 minutes buffer. My team is available next week on: Thu 7/15 09:00-11:30 PDT, Fri 7/16 13:00-16:00 PDT, or Mon 7/19 10:00-12:00 PDT. If none of those work, please propose two slots and we'll align.

I attached a short checklist (Redwood-PrivInfra-Checklist.pdf) to help your infra prepare. I'll also draft a mutual action plan after we lock the time (sending a spreadsheet).

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood-PrivInfra-Checklist.pdf (1 page PDF stub)
From: Aaron Miles <aaron.miles@datascape.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: DataScape IT <it@datascape.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Jul 2026 10:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: PrivInfra technical review & next steps after discovery call

Vanessa — thanks for the clear recap. Looping in our lead infra engineer, Maya Patel (m.patel@datascape.com) and our security lead, Ben Wu (b.wu@datascape.com), who will want to join the technical review.

The slots you proposed mostly work except Fri 7/16 after lunch is tough for our Asia team. Can we do Thu 7/15 at 10:30 PDT / 1:30 EDT? That should let Ben and Maya join remotely. If you require the full 60 minutes we're fine with that.

Also — can you confirm whether Redwood's private control plane requires egress to public endpoints for telemetry? Our security policy needs that spelled out before we share IAM roles.

Appreciate the checklist. Looking forward to the demo.

Best,
Aaron
Senior Product Manager, DataScape
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Jul 2026 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PrivInfra technical review & next steps after discovery call

Vanessa / Neha — quick internal note before we confirm with Aaron:

Agenda idea for the 60-minute slot (we should allow the full hour given their security questions):
- 00:00–05:00: introductions + discovery highlights (Vanessa)
- 05:00–20:00: proposed network diagram + NAT/eBPF tunnel options (me)
- 20:00–40:00: demo — private control plane flow, KMS integration, and audit log exports (Neha)
- 40:00–55:00: Q&A on telemetry/egress and SOC2 evidence (open)
- 55:00–60:00: next steps / mutual action plan owner assignment

On telemetry: short answer — telemetry is encrypted and can be configured to use customer-managed endpoints; by default there is minimal outbound telemetry for health signals but we can offer an air-gapped option for SOC2-high customers. I'll prepare a one-slide summary to address Ben's question.

Attachments for meeting prep: Datascape-MAP-v1.xlsx (mutual action plan draft) — I'll tailor the responsibilities after the call.

Karthik
Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Aaron / team — thanks for confirming. We are locked for Thu, July 15, 10:30–11:30 PDT (1:30–2:30 EDT). I've built a short agenda and shared a calendar invite. Please find the prep items below: 

Prep for your infra/security team:
- Share a network CIDR/peering constraints (high level) or provide a diagram if available
- Confirm KMS provider preference (AWS KMS or external HSM)
- List any approved outbound endpoints for telemetry (if you have policy docs we can review ahead)

What we'll bring:
- Network diagram templates and recommended firewall rules
- A live demo of the Private control plane deployment flow and KMS key binding
- SOC2 evidence checklist and audit-log retention options

Links: calendar invite (on your shared calendar), HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/DS-5532, drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-privinfra-datascape

If anything changes on your side, ping me here and we'll re-align. Looking forward to the discussion.

Regards,
